title: Snow Plow
reference: repeat 7 { if box_ahead { pick_up forward turn_left drop turn_right } else { forward } }
hints: Crates block the lane, and every crate has a snow nook right beside it.
Each move: if a crate is ahead, pick it up, step into its spot, put it in the nook on your left and turn back. Otherwise just go forward.
repeat 7 { if box_ahead { pick_up forward turn_left drop turn_right } else { forward } }
